Inspected upstream fbda4c85 immutable action.yml, main/post entries, input/runtime resolution, native pnpm download and lockfile verification/store cache code, plus the actual bundled dist. The verification-log post save is not independently safe: the existing GitHub low-trust cache token/namespace boundary remains essential. No source/lockfile/toolchain/public API/signing/provider/capacity/approval/fixture contract changes besides the reviewed immutable action version. Workflow gate and415 policy/workflow tests passed; removing the pnpm policy caused specific unsafe-cache and unknown-pin assertion failures and exact restoration passed. This is source/gate review; no new action-hosted, native-device or provider execution claimed.
